Mara: Quick sync — final run-of-show is attached (link below). Need sign-off on demo pacing + who owns the live fallback if the hosted model spikes. Please confirm by EOD. @Dylan @Sylvie @Aj

Dylan: Scanned it — looks tight. Current demos = 12m total. Can we trim to 9m? thinking 3x3 (overview, demo, CTA) per demo to keep q&a time.

Sylvie: 3x3 sounds right. Also recommend using the cached model variant for the audience-facing demo so we don't hit burst limits. We can call out tradeoffs in the script. :thumbsup:

Aj: I can run greenroom cues and call the live fallback if we see errors. Proposal: Dylan runs traffic and watches the dashboard, Mara handles intro + handoff. Putting cue-card snippet here:
```
00:00 Mara intro (90s)
01:30 Demo 1 — quick setup (45s) -> live demo (3:00) -> CTA (45s)
06:00 Demo 2 — setup (30s) -> cached demo (3:00) -> CTA (30s)
09:30 Demo 3 — lightning (3:00) -> final CTA (60s)
13:30 Live Q&A (15m)
```
(If any demo fails, Aj will trigger fallback: switch to pre-recorded clip + callout.)

Mara: Link to sheet + slides: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample/last-mile-demo (please don't edit the master; comment only)

Dylan: Confirmed. I'll run the traffic script and keep the dashboard open. If we exceed 90% of expected RPS for >30s, I'll call fallback.

Sylvie: I'll shorten two slide lines that are wordy and add a one-liner for the cached model tradeoff.

Aj: Greenroom timeline uploaded to drive (greenroom/last-mile-v2). I put cue cards in slide notes.

deploy-bot: :calendar: Rehearsal reminder — Full dress rehearsal tomorrow 15:00 PT. Joining link posted in calendar event.

Mara: Awesome — thanks team. If nobody objects, we'll ship these changes and lock slides at 17:00 PT today. :rocket:
